title: Database performance review
summary: Historical measured builds • semantic SQLite baseline → embedded TofuDB. Faster does not mean release-ready.

metrics.label: Submit → running P99
metrics.note: Median of two window P99s. Graceful reopen only; crash coverage is not established by this cohort.

metrics.label: Scheduled stream P99
metrics.note: Both backends miss the 1-second stream target. Another 21.1% reduction is needed from this candidate.

metrics.label: Settlement P99
metrics.note: Only two windows per backend. Candidate window range / median = 19.12%; not a confidence interval.

metrics.label: Warm full-response hydration
metrics.note: Median of four window means; exact response equality. Cold and concurrent workloads are not covered.

blocks.title: Streaming latency against the absolute target

metrics.label: Scheduled stream P99
metrics.note: Two windows per backend; median of window P99 values, not pooled request P99.

items.label: Conversation workload
items.value: 1000 conversations × four unique 8192-byte chunks; scheduled 1-second arrivals; strict durability; SQLite–Native–Native–SQLite windows.

items.label: Hydration workload
items.value: 50 conversations / 2000 settled turns; 30 warm sequential reads per window; four windows per backend; exact full-response equality.

items.label: Source
items.value: tofudb_direct_sqlite_pair_20261008.json; tofudb_hydration_exact_semantic_pair_20261009.json (retired docs/evidence/ artifacts; recoverable from git history)

items.label: Iteration priority
items.value: Profile scheduled-stream tail latency first. Retain hydration parity and gains. Investigate raw point-read and projection/history footprint separately.

items.label: Acceptance
items.value: Correctness and relative speed are distinct from budget and coverage acceptance. No overall speedup or current-checkout certification is claimed.
